implementation.status: Nunito (display and labels) and Nunito Sans (body and captions) are the Pillo brand faces. The stacks above are CSS fallbacks. They are not extracted from a reference site.
implementation.loading: Self-host Nunito and Nunito Sans with a font-display strategy and the fallback stacks. Do not load them from a third-party stylesheet.
implementation.wrapping: Use natural wraps; do not force desktop line breaks on mobile. Let controls grow if long translated labels need it. Voice stays short: “Today’s next step” and “You did it!”
implementation.metrics: Check fallback width and layout shift after Nunito loads. Display uses a heavy weight and at least 1.05 line height so rounded strokes stay readable.
implementation.responsive: Use rem plus viewport terms with clamp; verify actual browser text zoom and narrow reflow. Child-facing tiles use large type and at least 64px targets.
